_about: Answers of GET /api/account/characters/{id}/next-step for made-up saves, from the API's NextStepPlanner (hvmhfz_rest_api 829a6ef, guide window): HR1 with one Key Quest cleared, HR4 with three, GR 37, GR 650, HR7 before G Rank, GR 912 and GR 999 (end game). Every answer has 'overlay' (the in-game guide window) and every milestone a 'guide' link. Used by dev/check-next-step.js; regenerate when the API's words change.

hr1.summary: HR1 (HR 1), now HR 1. Key Quests: 1 of 6 cleared.
hr1.recommended: Clear the Key Quests left, starting with "Hunt the Boar Chief!". Then the Urgent Quest "[Urgent] Unknown Species, Fierce Wyvern" appears.
details: Key Quests left: "Hunt the Boar Chief!", "Chasing the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry", "Congalala's Territory", "Daimyo at the Water's Edge", "Great Forest Hypnocatrice".
Key Quests cleared: "Habitat of the Azure Hunter".
Open the Hunter Navi (Shift+C) for the free starter items, and meet your Halk in your house's Helper Area.
Urgent Quest "[Urgent] Unknown Species, Fierce Wyvern": appears in Quest Counter > Hunter Quests > Urgent Quests once every Key Quest is cleared. Clearing it raises your HR cap to 30 (HR2).

hr4.summary: HR4 (HR 51-99), now HR 75. Key Quests: 3 of 8 cleared.
hr4.recommended: Clear the Key Quests left, starting with "Bolt from the Blue". Then the Urgent Quest "[Urgent] Desert Crystal Scorpion" appears at HR 99.
details: Key Quests left: "Bolt from the Blue", "Pale Hypnocatrice Sighting Report", "Unleashed Dark Thunder", "All-Out Strike", "White Wreathed in Flame".
Key Quests cleared: "Proud Male Orugaron", "Flash! Highlands Kuarlusepusu", "Lawless Black-Purple".
My Tore opens: take your Poogie on quests (an Outfit and a Pugi Cuff add skill points).

Urgent Quest "[Urgent] Desert Crystal Scorpion": appears in Quest Counter > Hunter Quests > Urgent Quests once every Key Quest is cleared and you are HR 99. Clearing it raises your HR cap to 299 (HR5).

gr37.summary: GR 37: all of G★1-7 is open. Next milestone: G Rank Pugi Cuff Licence at GR50 (13 GR to go).
gr37.recommended: Build the Furogada or Samurai set from G★1-3 quests (the Hunter Navi GR tasks lead you through it), then move on to G★4-5.
details: GR50: buy the G Rank Pugi Cuff Licence from the Pugi Farm Manager (60P) to wear G Rank cuffs.

GR100: G Exotic quests (G counter > G Hunter Quests > G Exotic Quests; every clear gives 1 to 4 Exotic Gem, Exotic Bone or Exotic Shl) and the Musou Zinogre, Nargacuga and Deviljho quests, which ask for GR 100.
GR300: ★1 Zenith monsters (Zenith Monster Quests on the G counter) and Zenith armour and weapons.
GR500: ★2 Zenith monsters.
GR700: ★3 Zenith monsters.
GR900: ★4 Zenith monsters, the hardest standard fights in the game, and the 30 GRP quests (G Event Quests), which need GR 900.
GR999: Unlimited (UL) mode on quests with a blue flame, the Hiden Stamps in the Hunting Road shop and SR food in the food shop.

hr7.recommended: Clear the HR7 Urgent Quest, a Shantien repel on an airship: talk to the G Rank guildie (the girl with the umbrella) to post it. Then talk to the Guild Master to start G Rank.
details: In G Rank all of G★1-7 is open from GR1. The first milestone is the G Rank Pugi Cuff Licence at GR50.

overlay.line: Next: HR7 Urgent Quest, the Shantien repel

gr912.summary: GR 912: all of G★1-7 is open. Next milestone: Unlimited mode at GR999 (87 GR to go).
gr912.recommended: Clear the 30 GRP quests (G Event Quests) to reach GR 999; they also raise your weapon's GSR. Fight Zenith ★4 only for the parts your set still needs.
details: GR999: Unlimited (UL) mode on quests with a blue flame, the Hiden Stamps in the Hunting Road shop and SR food in the food shop.
Reached: GR50 G Rank Pugi Cuff Licence, GR100 G Exotic quests, GR300 Zenith ★1, GR500 Zenith ★2, GR700 Zenith ★3 and GR900 Zenith ★4.
The 30 GRP quests (G Event Quests, GR 900 and up) also raise your weapon's GSR, up to 999 for each weapon type.

gr999.summary: GR 999: every G Rank milestone is reached.
gr999.recommended: End game: pick your long goals: the Hunting Road, the Sky Corridor, Raviente and Hiden. Most players do several at once.
details: GR points: 13,716,950.
Reached: GR50 G Rank Pugi Cuff Licence, GR100 G Exotic quests, GR300 Zenith ★1, GR500 Zenith ★2, GR700 Zenith ★3, GR900 Zenith ★4 and GR999 Unlimited mode.
The 30 GRP quests (G Event Quests, GR 900 and up) also raise your weapon's GSR, up to 999 for each weapon type.
End game: the Hunting Road and the Sky Corridor (H.Road/Sky Corridor counter), Raviente (Kieru in the Caravan Area) and Hiden (Hiden armour made into decorations).
